      +-------------------------------+
      |  Ticker fires                 |<-------------------------+
      |  every Interval seconds       |                          |
      +---------------+---------------+                          |
                      |                                          |
                      v                                          |
      +-------------------------------+                          |
      |  Apply changed Interval       |                          |
      +---------------+---------------+                          |
                      |                                          |
                      v                                          |
      +-------------------------------+   all resolvers failed   |
      |  Resolve public IPv4 address  |------------------------->|
      +---------------+---------------+                          |
                      |                                          |
                      v                                          |
      +-------------------------------+                          |
      |  Store IP address if new      |                          |
      +---------------+---------------+                          |
                      |                                          |
                      v                                          |
      +-------------------------------+   no job outdated        |
      |  Find jobs whose last IP      |------------------------->|
      |  differs from the current one |                          |
      +---------------+---------------+                          |
                      |                                          |
                      v  for each job                            |
      +-------------------------------+                          |
      |  Decrypt params (AES-GCM)     |   error: log, next job   |
      |  Send update to provider      |                          |
      |  Remember IP on the job       |                          |
      +---------------+---------------+                          |
                      |                                          |
                      +------------------------------------------+
